content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Nagaland Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Nagaland recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow and Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies. One each for Junior Research Fellow (JRF), Project Associate I, and Project Associate II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: For JRF, you need an M.E./M.Tech or equivalent degree in Computer Science and Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical, Communication, or Electronics Engineering with at least 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates with a B.E./B.Tech degree apply for the Project Associate I position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a B.E./B.Tech in relevant fields or MCA or a Master's Degree in Geography/GIS/Remote Sensing/Geo-Informatics/Earth Observation/Earth Sciences can apply for Project Associate I.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum experience required for the Project Associate II post?
faq.answer: For Project Associate II, candidates need a B.E./B.Tech degree in relevant fields and at least 2 years of experience in Research and Development in industrial or academic institutions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is Rs 37,000/- per month plus 9% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their applications, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for NIT Nagaland recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is via email. You need to send your application to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category of candidates.
